note: Wabasha County zoning districts are published only in the Schneider Beacon viewer (bot-protected, not a public ArcGIS REST service) and as static PDF zoning maps for the county and the City of Wabasha. The county lists zoning districts as coming soon on the MN Geospatial Commons and otherwise as a fee-based request. No queryable zoning polygon service was found for the county or its cities.
